      class Averages extends JFrame implements Serializable

      • Serialized Fields

        • data
          int[] data
          An array to hold data to be averaged. This array will not always have actual data in every element. As data is added it will be placed in elements 0, 1, 2 in that order, and the variable "top" declared below will always indicate where the most recently added item was placed.
        • dataEntryField
          JTextField dataEntryField
          Hold the GUI components, including the averages display area that holds the actual rainfall data.
        • displayArea
          JTextArea displayArea
        • size
          int size
          A constant to be used as the maximum array size.
        • top
          int top
          This holds the index of the last inserted data element. So: -1 if there is no data, 0 when one item is present 1 when there are two items, and so on
